source_version: Official SIGMA 12 (2016) article 106, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2016.106; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
license_fact: Named authors retain copyright; SIGMA publishes their papers under CC BY 4.0. The retained native journal source corresponds to the official DOI and PDF.
changes: Standalone excerpt wrapper, attribution, selected task scope and editorial notices added.
Theorem and section positions restored at boundaries; displayed equations use internally consistent excerpt numbering.
Cited bibliography entries retained under original reference numbers.

The unavailable bbm identity font is replaced by the equivalent double-struck identity glyph from the portable DejaVu Math TeX Gyre font; original identity-symbol uses are unchanged. Standard xy is loaded through usepackage rather than the journal input shorthand.
The unused stmaryrd package is omitted from the standalone preamble; no selected symbol depends on it.
The journal-specific cmss11 metric is replaced by the same Computer Modern sans-serif face at 11-point size using the installed cmss10 metric.
Legacy uppercase-Greek slot macros are aliased to the corresponding standard LaTeX Greek symbols to avoid Unicode-font control-character slots. Original Greek-symbol invocations are unchanged.
